summary: This Form 6-K reports the results of ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc.'s annual general meeting held on June 16, 2026. Shareholders approved routine items including receipt of audited financial statements, re-election of directors, auditor reappointment, and general mandates to issue up to 20% additional shares and repurchase up to 10% of shares. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or going-private transaction is disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate governance update for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. proxy result announcement. There are no deal terms or change-of-control implications to analyze.
